name: PS1-490037 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant Type Ia supernova PS1-490037, seen by Hubble.
label: ps1c490037-hubble
story: Somewhere in this field shone PS1-490037, a Type Ia supernova found by the Pan-STARRS survey. Hubble followed it to measure a precise cosmic distance and help trace the expansion history of the universe.

claims.text: PS1-490037 is a Type Ia supernova
Hubble program 13046 (RAISIN) observed the target PS1-C490037
The program followed Type Ia supernovae found in Pan-STARRS fields to measure precise cosmic distances and the cosmic expansion history
